query: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, r.role, m.title ORDER BY m.title
MATCH (m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p:Person) WHERE m.title = 'The Matrix' RETURN collect(p.name) AS cast
MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, m.title
MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie) RETURN m.title, avg(r.stars) AS avg_stars ORDER BY avg_stars DESC LIMIT 3
MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.released >= 2000 RETURN count(m)
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born < 1966 WITH p ORDER BY p.born LIMIT 2 RETURN p.name
MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS*1..2]->(q:Person) RETURN DISTINCT q.name
UNWIND ['The Matrix', 'John Wick'] AS t MATCH (m:Movie {title: t}) RETURN m.released
MATCH (m:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g:Genre) RETURN g.name, count(*) AS n
MATCH (p:Person) RETURN CASE WHEN p.born < 1965 THEN 'older' ELSE 'younger' END AS grp, p.name
MATCH (a:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(b:Person) WHERE a.name < b.name RETURN a.name, b.name, m.title
MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title AS title UNION MATCH (g:Genre) RETURN g.name AS title
MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.title STARTS WITH 'The' RETURN m
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name CONTAINS 'Keanu' RETURN p
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.name IN ['Keanu Reeves', 'Lana Wachowski'] RETURN p.born
MATCH (a:Actor) RETURN a.name, a.born
MATCH p = (a:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(b:Person) RETURN length(p)
MATCH (p:Person) WITH p.name AS name, p.born AS born WHERE born > 1960 RETURN name
MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.rating IS NOT NULL RETURN m.title, m.rating
MATCH (p:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) WHERE m.released = 1999 RETURN p.name
MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie) RETURN a.name, m.title
MATCH (n) WHERE n.title = 'The Matrix' RETURN n
MATCH (p:Person)-[r:ACTED_IN|DIRECTED]->(m:Movie) RETURN p.name, m.title
MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title, [(m)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(p) | p.name] AS cast
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE NOT (p)-[:DIRECTED]->() RETURN p.name
CALL db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes('Movie', 'Matrix') YIELD node, score RETURN node.title, score
CALL db.idx.vector.queryNodes('Movie', 'embedding', 2, vecf32([0.1, 0.2, 0.3])) YIELD node, score RETURN node.title, score
CALL db.idx.fulltext.queryRelationships('ACTED_IN', 'Neo') YIELD relationship RETURN relationship.role
CALL db.labels() YIELD label RETURN label
MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title LIMIT 10
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.born > $year RETURN p.name
MATCH (m:Movie) WHERE m.rating > $min RETURN m.title
